consequence.statement: The -tsdb.shipper.shared-store configuration option is no longer honoured; if its value does not match object_store for all tsdb periods, access to those indexes is lost.

original.statement: The CLI flag -tsdb.shipper.shared-store and its YAML equivalent tsdb.shipper.shared_store are removed in Loki 3.0.0 and are no longer honoured; if their value does not match object_store for all tsdb periods, index access is lost and manual migration is required.

decision.reason: [ev-43cc6d389282] says the shared-store flags/YAML settings are removed and `object_store` in period_config is now used for the index store, so a configured `-tsdb.shipper.shared-store` [ev-15a875cd9a39] stops being honoured. [ev-af5a4b32c120] states that where it mismatched `object_store`, access to the index for those periods is lost until index tables are moved or copied, which supports an action-eligible kind at high severity. The evidence does not say startup fails on the leftover flag, so setting-ignored (not upgrade-blocked) fits.
